name: Common Objects in 3D (CO3D)
description: Common Objects in 3D (CO3D) is a massive dataset of multi-view 3D object scans created by Meta AI Research. CO3D comprises 18,619 video sequences capturing everyday objects across 50 MS-COCO categories. Each sequence includes calibrated camera intrinsic and extrinsic poses, semi-dense 3D point cloud reconstructions from COLMAP, and foreground object segmentation masks, providing an authoritative benchmark for novel-view synthesis, NeRFs, and 3D reconstruction.
